Mobile sidebar shows JVS icon only
Active navigation links have aria-current='page' attribute
Active link shows Racing Red left border accent (border-l-4 border-primary-500)

findings: JVSLogo component successfully integrated into Sidebar navigation. Desktop sidebar (md breakpoint and above) displays full logo variant with JVS icon, AUTOWORKS text, JVS Bongabon tagline, and racing stripes. Mobile sidebar displays icon-only variant with JVS letters and chrome gradient. All navigation links now include aria-current='page' attribute on active links for improved accessibility. Active link border increased from border-l-2 to border-l-4 (Racing Red #950304) for better visibility. Build and lint passed with no errors. Manual verification required: Run 'npm run dev' and test responsive logo switching by resizing browser at md breakpoint (~768px), verify chrome gradient renders correctly, check aria-current attribute in DevTools on active links, and confirm Racing Red left border appears on active navigation items.
